fixes.after: Halaman berlabel %2$@ yang %1$@

fixes.key: The MP3 has chapters for the first %@ of its %lld headings; export as M4B for a chapter for each.

english.one: The MP3 has chapters for the first %@ of its %lld heading; export as M4B for a chapter for each.
english.other: The MP3 has chapters for the first %@ of its %lld headings; export as M4B for a chapter for each.

before.other: MP3 memiliki bab untuk %@ pertama dari %lld tajuknya; ekspor sebagai M4B untuk satu bab bagi masing-masing.

after.other: MP3 memiliki bab untuk %@ pertama dari %lld tajuknya; ekspor sebagai M4B agar setiap tajuk memiliki bab.

fixes.why: natural: untuk satu bab bagi masing-masing copied for a chapter for each word by word; now so that every heading has a chapter
